const draft = `# Elm Quay Housing samlar reparationsanmälningarna i en vy

Egna kategorier och fortsatt telefonanmälan präglade Elm Quay Housings försök med en gemensam reparationslogg i två byggnader. Underhållsteamets erfarenheter visar vilka förberedelser det vill göra inför nästa steg – och varför tidsuppgifterna från försöket behöver läsas med försiktighet.

Av användaren. Publicerat av Svale Systems.

Elm Quay Housing förvaltar 640 lägenheter. I september 2025 beslutade bolagets eget underhållsteam att prova en gemensam logg för reparationer i två byggnader. Telefonanmälningar och mejl hade tidigare lagrats var för sig, och teamet ville att personal på olika skift skulle kunna se samma information.

## Underhållsteamet väljer arbetssättet

Teamet valde Svale Systems efter att ha testat om loggen kunde visa status för varje reparation. Någon jämförelse med en annan leverantör finns inte i underlaget.

De boende kunde fortsätta att anmäla per telefon. Svale konfigurerade loggen och utbildade sex medarbetare vid två tillfällen. Maya Lind, arbetsledare för underhållet, beskriver utgångspunkten i en mejlintervju:

– Vi ville att kvällsskiftet skulle se vad morgonskiftet redan hade gjort. Kategorierna var våra; Svale hjälpte oss att lägga in dem i loggen.

## Försöksanteckningen avgränsar resultaten

Försöket pågick i åtta veckor. Enligt Elm Quays interna försöksanteckning från den 4 december 2025 registrerades 31 reparationsanmälningar. Siffran omfattar inte akuta ärenden eller arbete som beställts före försöket.

Mediantiden från anmälan till tilldelning av ärendet var två arbetsdagar under försöket, jämfört med tre under den föregående åttaveckorsperioden. Arbetsbelastningen skilde sig mellan perioderna, och anteckningen tillskriver uttryckligen inte skillnaden programvaran.

Det finns inga mätningar av kostnader, boendes nöjdhet eller tid till färdig reparation.

## Maya Lind bedömer försöket

Teamet har ännu inte utökat försöket. Beslutet ska fattas efter att teamet har kontrollerat hur kategorierna fungerar för större reparationer. Om förberedelserna skriver Maya Lind:

– Vi lade mer tid på att komma överens om kategorierna än på att registrera de första anmälningarna. Jag skulle avsätta den tiden innan nästa byggnad kommer i gång.

– Jag skulle välja att göra försöket igen. Att ha en samlad vy över anmälningarna hjälper oss, men jag skulle avsätta en extra vecka för förberedelser.

## Läs checklistan inför ett eget införande

Inför ett eget försök kan du ta med dig Linds reservation om förberedelsetiden. Vill du planera ett införande kan du läsa [Svale Systems checklista för införande](https://example.invalid/svale/checklist) som nästa steg.
`;
store("write_draft",draft);
text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"write_tmp=$(mktemp -d /private/var/folders/cs/vgp_x_353zd9frkjpysp7zdw0000gn/T/kntnt-native-session-w8zwcb3a/scratch/write-uv.XXXXXX)\ncleanup_write_tmp() {\n  python3 - \"$write_tmp\" <<'PY'\nimport shutil, sys\nshutil.rmtree(sys.argv[1])\nPY\n}\ntrap cleanup_write_tmp EXIT\nTMPDIR=\"$write_tmp\" UV_NO_CACHE=1 UV_NO_PROJECT=1 uv run --no-cache --no-project .agents/skills/kntnt/library/scripts/article_anatomy.py - <<'WRITE_DRAFT'\n"+draft+"WRITE_DRAFT",max_output_tokens:10000}));

*** Add File: /private/var/folders/cs/vgp_x_353zd9frkjpysp7zdw0000gn/T/kntnt-native-session-w8zwcb3a/scratch/write-source-check-igbb1lzv/report-1.md
+# Source and quotation comparison
+
+I read the complete source package, the complete draft, and the supplied quotation guidance. This report checks support and quotation translation only. It does not review general editing or mechanics.
+
+## Complete claim accounting
+
+The passages below cover the title, introduction, byline, every body statement, all headings, all quotations, and the optional next step. Source excerpts retain their English wording and relevant qualifications.
+
+| Draft passage | Source passage in its own words | Comparison |
+|---|---|---|
+| “Elm Quay Housing samlar reparationsanmälningarna i en vy” | “In September 2025 its own maintenance team decided to trial a shared repair log in two buildings.” “Elm Quay's internal trial note, 4 December 2025, says that 31 repair reports were entered.” “Having one view of the reports helps us, but I would leave an extra week for preparation.” | Supported as a journalistic present-tense title for the described case. The introduction and dated body identify the trial. It does not claim causal improvement, completion of repairs, or expansion. The single view is supported by Lind's description. |
+| “Egna kategorier och fortsatt telefonanmälan präglade Elm Quay Housings försök med en gemensam reparationslogg i två byggnader.” | “In September 2025 its own maintenance team decided to trial a shared repair log in two buildings.” “The maintenance team designed its categories and kept telephone reporting open for residents.” “We spent more time agreeing on the categories than entering the first reports.” | The shared log, two buildings, customer-owned categories, and continued reporting route are supported. “Präglade” is an editorial characterization of these expressly supplied choices; it adds no numerical valuation or unsupported effect. |
+| “Arbetsledaren Maya Lind ger sin bedömning av försöket” | “Customer interview with maintenance supervisor Maya Lind, complete usable quotations:” “I would choose to do the trial again. Having one view of the reports helps us, but I would leave an extra week for preparation.” “Her final quotation is her actual, qualified assessment. It is not an inference from the figures.” | Same person, role, and personally attributed assessment. The draft does not turn the assessment into a result inferred from the measurements. |
+| “den interna anteckningen sätter gränser för vad tidsuppgifterna kan säga” | “The periods had different workloads, and the note explicitly does not attribute the difference to the software. There are no cost, resident-satisfaction or completion-time measurements.” | Supported editorial inference about evidential limits, subsequently explained. It does not attribute a causal conclusion to the note. |
+| “Av användaren” | No source passage is required: the dispatch explicitly supplies this invocation-based byline role. | No finding. The brief supplies no named author, and the dispatch expressly authorizes this role attribution. |
+| “Publicerat av Svale Systems” | “The publisher is the supplier, Svale Systems.” “The supplier approved publication of this case as supplier-published material; it is not independent journalism.” | Supported publisher identification. The visible byline and third-person supplier references preserve the publication context. |
+| “Elm Quay Housing förvaltar 640 lägenheter.” | “Elm Quay Housing manages 640 flats.” | Same organization, activity, and count. In this housing context, “lägenheter” names the flats being managed. No added size assessment. |
+| “I september 2025 beslutade bolagets eget underhållsteam att prova en gemensam logg för reparationer i två byggnader.” | “In September 2025 its own maintenance team decided to trial a shared repair log in two buildings.” | Same date, customer team, decision, shared log, and two-building scope. “Prova” retains trial status; it does not imply a completed general rollout. |
+| “Telefonanmälningar och mejl hade tidigare lagrats var för sig” | “Previously telephone reports and emails were stored separately.” | Same reporting channels, earlier time, and separation. |
+| “teamet ville att personal på olika skift skulle kunna se samma information.” | “The team wanted staff on different shifts to see the same information.” | Same team intention and staff scope. “Skulle kunna” expresses the intended ability to view shared information, without claiming that all staff actually viewed it. |
+| Heading: “Underhållsteamet väljer arbetssättet” | “The maintenance team designed its categories and kept telephone reporting open for residents.” “It chose Svale Systems after testing whether the log could show the status of each repair.” | Supported editorial heading: the customer team makes the supplied choices. Its present tense functions as a case heading, alongside past-tense events in the body. |
+| “Teamet valde Svale Systems efter att ha testat om loggen kunde visa status för varje reparation.” | “It chose Svale Systems after testing whether the log could show the status of each repair. No comparison with another supplier is available.” | Same choosing subject, named supplier, prior test, and each-repair scope. “Om … kunde” retains what was tested, rather than asserting a particular test result. The following draft sentence retains the comparison limitation. |
+| “Någon jämförelse med en annan leverantör finns inte i underlaget.” | “No comparison with another supplier is available.” | Same lack of available comparative material. The draft appropriately locates the absence in the material; it does not claim that no comparison ever happened. |
+| “De boende kunde fortsätta att anmäla per telefon.” | “The maintenance team designed its categories and kept telephone reporting open for residents.” | Same continued availability to residents. The draft asserts ability, not actual usage or resident satisfaction. |
+| “Svale konfigurerade loggen och utbildade sex medarbetare vid två tillfällen.” | “Svale configured the log and trained six staff during two sessions.” | Same supplier, configuration, six staff, and two training events. In this sentence “vid två tillfällen” naturally denotes the two training sessions; it does not assert two different dates, a duration, or more training than the material supplies. No concrete contextual distinction warrants a finding. |
+| “Maya Lind, arbetsledare för underhållet, beskriver utgångspunkten i en mejlintervju:” | “Customer interview with maintenance supervisor Maya Lind, complete usable quotations:” “All interviews occurred by email, and no physical scene, emotion or remembered dialogue is provided.” | Same person, maintenance supervisory role, and interview medium. The subsequent quotation states the team's original intention. No spoken encounter or scene is invented. |
+| “Vi ville att kvällsskiftet skulle se vad morgonskiftet redan hade gjort.” | “We wanted the evening shift to see what the morning shift had already done.” | Same first-person plural intention, two shifts, completed earlier work, and viewing goal. Translation is idiomatic and preserves the stance and chronology. |
+| “Kategorierna var våra; Svale hjälpte oss att lägga in dem i loggen.” | “The categories were ours; Svale helped us put them into the log.” | Same ownership and assistance attribution. Neither the category design nor implementation assistance is transferred from the customer to Svale. “Lägga in” is an idiomatic rendering of entering them into the log. |
+| Heading: “Försöksanteckningen avgränsar resultaten” | “Elm Quay's internal trial note, 4 December 2025, says that 31 repair reports were entered. It excludes emergencies and work ordered before the trial.” “The periods had different workloads, and the note explicitly does not attribute the difference to the software.” | Supported characterization of exclusions and interpretive limits. No added measured result. |
+| “Försöket pågick i åtta veckor.” | “The trial lasted eight weeks.” | Same duration and event. No unsupported exact start or end date is supplied. |
+| “Enligt Elm Quays interna försöksanteckning från den 4 december 2025 registrerades 31 reparationsanmälningar.” | “Elm Quay's internal trial note, 4 December 2025, says that 31 repair reports were entered. It excludes emergencies and work ordered before the trial.” | Same actual source, date, recorded item, and count. The following sentence preserves exclusions. “Elm Quay” is the source's own short form of Elm Quay Housing. |
+| “Siffran omfattar inte akuta ärenden eller arbete som beställts före försöket.” | “It excludes emergencies and work ordered before the trial.” | Same excluded urgent cases and previously ordered work. In this repair-reporting context “akuta ärenden” names emergency cases; the draft does not extend the 31 to them or to prior orders. |
+| “Mediantiden från anmälan till tilldelning av ärendet var två arbetsdagar under försöket, jämfört med tre under den föregående åttaveckorsperioden.” | “Median time from report to assignment was two working days during the trial and three in the preceding eight-week period. The periods had different workloads, and the note explicitly does not attribute the difference to the software.” | Same median, report-to-assignment interval, working-day units, trial measurement, preceding eight-week comparison, and values. “Tilldelning av ärendet” describes assignment of the reported repair case, not completion of the repair. The following sentence carries the workload and non-attribution qualification. |
+| “Arbetsbelastningen skilde sig mellan perioderna” | “The periods had different workloads” | Same non-equivalence of workloads. No direction, amount, or explanation is invented. |
+| “anteckningen tillskriver uttryckligen inte skillnaden programvaran.” | “the note explicitly does not attribute the difference to the software.” | Same document, explicit refusal of causal attribution, and difference. It does not claim that the software certainly had no effect. |
+| “Det finns inga mätningar av kostnader, boendes nöjdhet eller tid till färdig reparation.” | “There are no cost, resident-satisfaction or completion-time measurements.” | Same three unavailable measurement categories. “Tid till färdig reparation” refers to repair completion time in the supplied repair context. No claim of cost saving, satisfaction improvement, or completion-time change. |
+| Heading: “Maya Lind bedömer försöket” | “Her final quotation is her actual, qualified assessment. It is not an inference from the figures.” | Same personally attributed qualified assessment. The heading does not claim wider endorsement. |
+| “Teamet har ännu inte utökat försöket.” | “The trial has not yet expanded; the team will decide after checking how the categories work for larger repairs.” | Same current lack of expansion. The team is established as the trial's customer-side decision maker. No expansion is reported or promised. |
+| “Beslutet ska fattas efter att teamet har kontrollerat hur kategorierna fungerar för större reparationer.” | “the team will decide after checking how the categories work for larger repairs.” | Same future decision, ordering, checking activity, and larger-repair scope. The outcome of the decision remains open. The passive sentence retains the team as the checking actor and, in context, as the decision maker. |
+| “Om förberedelserna skriver Maya Lind:” | “All interviews occurred by email” and the following complete quotation: “We spent more time agreeing on the categories than entering the first reports. I would set that time aside before the next building starts.” | Correct written-interview attribution and topic. No quotation source or mode is invented. |
+| “Vi lade mer tid på att komma överens om kategorierna än på att registrera de första anmälningarna.” | “We spent more time agreeing on the categories than entering the first reports.” | Same first-person plural experience and relative time comparison. No exact duration or evaluative scale is added. “Komma överens” preserves agreement, rather than changing it into mere configuration. |
+| “Jag skulle avsätta den tiden innan vi börjar i nästa byggnad.” | “I would set that time aside before the next building starts.” | “Jag skulle avsätta den tiden” preserves first-person singular, conditional recommendation, and the time spent agreeing on categories. “Innan vi börjar i nästa byggnad” introduces a first-person plural starting actor absent from the source clause. Finding T1 below. |
+| “Jag skulle välja att göra försöket igen.” | “I would choose to do the trial again.” “Her final quotation is her actual, qualified assessment. It is not an inference from the figures.” | Same personal conditional choice and trial scope. It neither becomes a firm future plan nor a recommendation to all housing companies. |
+| “Att ha en samlad vy över anmälningarna hjälper oss” | “Having one view of the reports helps us” | Same personally attributed benefit to the plural group. “Samlad vy” preserves the one-view meaning in this shared-log context. No numerical effect, universal customer benefit, or causal change to assignment time is asserted. |
+| “men jag skulle avsätta en extra vecka för förberedelser.” | “but I would leave an extra week for preparation.” | Same opposing qualification, first-person singular conditional, extra week, and preparation. “Avsätta” naturally means reserving preparation time here. The reservation survives intact. |
+| Heading: “Läs checklistan inför ett eget införande” | “The optional next step is the supplied implementation checklist at https://example.invalid/svale/checklist; it is a document to read, not a consultation booking or a product trial.” | Supported editorial invitation to read the specified document. It does not promise a consultation or trial. |
+| “Inför ett eget försök kan du ta med dig Linds reservation om förberedelsetiden.” | “I would choose to do the trial again. Having one view of the reports helps us, but I would leave an extra week for preparation.” | Author's optional advice resting on Lind's actual reservation. No factual claim that every reader needs an extra week, or that Lind recommended Svale to all companies. |
+| “Vill du planera ett införande kan du läsa Svale Systems checklista för införande … som nästa steg.” Link: `https://example.invalid/svale/checklist` | “The publisher is the supplier, Svale Systems.” “The optional next step is the supplied implementation checklist at https://example.invalid/svale/checklist; it is a document to read, not a consultation booking or a product trial.” | Same optional reading destination, checklist subject, supplier association, and exact URL. The conditional invitation adds no claim of checklist efficacy or required action. |
+
+## Pronoun, person, number, and natural-gender accounting
+
+Referent identity is considered separately from the features a pronoun asserts.
+
+| Draft form | Source form and evidence | Person, number, natural gender, and result |
+|---|---|---|
+| “sin bedömning” | “Her final quotation is her actual, qualified assessment.” | Swedish reflexive possessive agrees with the third-person singular subject Maya Lind; it asserts no natural gender. The source independently uses feminine “Her,” but the Swedish draft does not add a gender assertion. |
+| “bolagets eget underhållsteam”; recurring “teamet” | “its own maintenance team”; “The team”; “It chose Svale Systems”; “the team will decide” | The institution and collective team remain grammatically singular entities. Swedish neuter gender in “bolaget,” “teamet,” and “eget” is grammatical, not an assertion about people's gender. No individual is invented. |
+| First quotation: “Vi,” “våra,” “oss” | “We wanted”; “The categories were ours”; “Svale helped us” | First-person plural group is explicitly present in the source. The possessive form's agreement with plural “kategorierna” does not assert any gender of owners. The group is presented from Lind's perspective, not as Svale's first-person corporate voice. |
+| First quotation: “dem” | “put them into the log” | Third-person plural object refers to categories in both versions. It asserts no human natural gender. |
+| Second quotation: first “Vi” | “We spent more time” | First-person plural is directly supported. Group identity does not need to be narrowed to a named list of people. |
+| Second quotation: “Jag” | “I would set that time aside” | First-person singular is directly supported. “Jag” has no natural-gender feature. |
+| Second quotation: added “vi” in “innan vi börjar” | “before the next building starts” | The source subordinate subject is the singular building, with an implicit activity beginning there. It supplies no first-person plural subject for the start. Existing “We” in the previous sentence establishes who spent time agreeing, not necessarily who will begin the next building's trial. This added person/number claim is T1. |
+| Second quotation: “den tiden” | “that time” | Both demonstratives point to category-agreement time. Swedish common gender in “den” agrees grammatically with “tiden”; it is not human gender. No new duration is asserted. |
+| Third quotation: both instances of “jag” | “I would choose”; “I would leave” | First-person singular and conditional stance are directly supported. Neither clause asserts natural gender or a completed future decision. |
+| Third quotation: “oss” | “helps us” | Same first-person plural beneficiaries. No transformation into all residents or all housing companies. |
+| “du” in closing advice; implied second-person addressee of “Läs” | Brief: “Write a journalistic customer case for operations managers at small housing companies.” “The optional next step is the supplied implementation checklist” | Singular Swedish reader address is a rhetorical form of the author's invitation. It is not an assertion that the audience consists of one actual individual or has any particular natural gender. |
+| Other demonstratives and relative forms, including “samma,” “var för sig,” and “som” | “the same information”; “stored separately”; “work ordered before the trial”; the supplied link description | These express the supported relationships and antecedents described in the accounting table. Their Swedish grammatical agreement adds no person or natural-gender information. |
+
+## Findings
+
+### T1 — Translation adds an unestablished first-person plural actor
+
+**Draft:** “Jag skulle avsätta den tiden innan vi börjar i nästa byggnad.”
+
+**Source:** “I would set that time aside before the next building starts.”
+
+**Supported unchanged part:** Lind would reserve the category-agreement time before the next building's start. The conditional “would” and the referent of “that time” are preserved.
+
+**Changed part:** “Vi börjar” supplies a first-person plural group as the actor starting in the next building. The source makes the building the subject and leaves the starting personnel implicit. “We spent more time agreeing on the categories” supplies a group for the earlier preparation experience; it does not establish that the same group carries out the next building's start. “The trial has not yet expanded; the team will decide after checking how the categories work for larger repairs” establishes the team's decision role, not the identity of future implementation personnel.
+
+**Concrete divergence, source to draft:** The original team could agree on categories and decide whether to extend the trial, while a different building team or contractor starts the log in the next building. Lind could reserve category-preparation time before that building starts without her “we” group beginning there. This future arrangement is compatible with the package. The source does not exclude it. The draft's first-person plural start introduces an actor the source need not imply.
+
+**Reverse-direction test:** “Vi börjar i nästa byggnad” also ties the deadline to the original group's own start. In a future arrangement where that group begins its work only after another group has started the building's trial, reserving time before the original group's start need not mean reserving it before the building's trial starts. The source's stated deadline is the building's start. The package gives no future staffing or handover schedule excluding this distinction. This is the same translation defect, not a second finding.
+
+**Smallest supported repair:** “Jag skulle avsätta den tiden innan försöket startar i nästa byggnad.” The context establishes that the start concerns this trial; the repair makes that settled activity explicit while leaving the actor unclaimed. It preserves Lind's conditional stance and preparation recommendation.
+
+**Classification:** Translation finding involving an added actor and person/number features. The same addition is also a source-support issue within the translated quotation. No separate defect is counted.
+
+## Other quotation conclusions
+
+The first quotation preserves the contrast between customer-owned categories and supplier assistance. The second quotation preserves the experiential time comparison and conditional advice apart from T1. The final quotation preserves personal willingness to repeat the trial, the benefit as Lind's assessment, and the additional preparation week. None becomes a recommendation to every company or an inference from the figures. The quotations add team experience and a personal reservation beyond the numerical account. No quotation introduces a scene, emotion, remembered spoken exchange, or natural-gender assertion.
+
+## Completion status
+
+Complete: the entire draft has been compared with the entire supplied source and quotation guidance. One unresolved finding remains: T1, the added first-person plural starting actor in the second quotation. No draft or source file was changed.
*** End Patch"));

## Pronoun, person, number and natural-gender accounting

- **“sin bedömning”**: reflexive ownership refers to Maya Lind, the singular subject. It contributes no natural gender. The source supplies the named individual's actual assessment.
- **“bolagets eget underhållsteam”, “teamet”, “Elm Quays”**: organisational/team reference and ownership agree with “its own maintenance team”, “The team” and “Elm Quay's”. Swedish grammatical neuter agreement in “eget” describes the noun “team”, not the natural gender of team members. No statement that the team is singular in human membership follows from the singular collective noun.
- **“De boende” and “boendes”**: residents are plural people, as in the source's “residents” and “resident-satisfaction”. Neither phrase asserts natural gender.
- **First quotation, “Vi”, “våra”, “oss”**: first person plural matches “We”, “ours” and “us”. The interview and narrative locate the speaker with the maintenance team; this does not identify the group's exact membership as the six trainees or establish any members' genders.
- **First quotation, “dem”**: third person plural object refers to the categories, matching “them”. Categories are nonhuman; no natural-gender feature is asserted.
- **Second quotation, “Vi”**: first person plural matches “We”; team experience is preserved without an additional membership or gender claim.
- **Second quotation, “Jag”**: first person singular matches “I”, supplied as Maya Lind's usable quotation. It identifies one speaker without specifying natural gender.
- **Second quotation, “den tiden”**: demonstrative reference to category-agreement time matches “that time”. The grammatical common gender of “den” agrees with “tiden”; it is not human gender.
- **Final quotation, both instances of “jag”**: first person singular matches both instances of “I”. No natural-gender claim is made.
- **Final quotation, “oss”**: first person plural matches “us”; usefulness is asserted for the speaker's group without specifying each person's role, number or gender.
- **“Det finns”**: impersonal grammatical subject in the statement about absent measurements, with no person, referent or natural gender assertion.
- **Both closing instances of “du”**: second person singular reader address, part of editorial advice and the optional next step. No audience population, personal event or natural gender is claimed. The heading's imperative also addresses the reader without a natural-gender feature.
- **“Siffran”, “skillnaden”, “perioderna”, “Beslutet”, “försöket”, “loggen”, “anmälningarna”**: anaphoric definite noun phrases keep the stated count, difference, two periods, expansion decision, trial, log and report referents. Their grammatical gender/number is not a natural-gender assertion. The draft contains no “hon”, “han” or other assertion of Maya Lind's natural gender.

## Translated-quotation review

All three supplied usable quotations appear as separate speech-dash paragraphs attributed to Maya Lind in an email interview. Their first-person standpoint and actual qualifications are preserved. The first retains the shift-specific purpose and customer's ownership of categories. The second retains the comparative preparation experience and conditional next-building advice. The third retains conditional willingness to repeat the trial, experienced usefulness and the extra-week reservation within the same quotation.

The Swedish is idiomatic speech. No concrete obstruction to reading the same meaning, certainty, stance or distinctive voice was identified. Clarifying “the next building starts” as “försöket startar i nästa byggnad” is supported by the trial's explicit expansion context. No quotation splices independent remarks into invented dialogue, adds a scene or emotion, replaces Lind's actual assessment with an inference from the figures, or universalises the supplier recommendation.

**Source-support findings: none.** The exclusion scope was considered explicitly in item 21. Terms in the narrative name the same items or stages in the supplied context: flats/lägenheter, repair reports/reparationsanmälningar, shared repair log/gemensam reparationslogg, assignment/tilldelning av ärendet, completion time/tid till färdig reparation, and implementation checklist/checklista för införande. No compatible concrete countercase establishes a different named or measured thing in this context.

The draft preserves the customer as acting party, supplier narration in third person, qualified customer assessment, measurement limitations, unavailable comparison evidence and the reading destination of the optional link. It asserts no software causation, monetary saving, resident satisfaction outcome, completed-repair improvement or customer helplessness.
